name: read_all_statements
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
v=json.loads(Path('fixed20-provenance.json').read_text())
for x in v:
 raw=Path('originals/'+str(x['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes(); s=raw.decode(); pos=s.index('"statement"'); start=s.index('"',s.index(':',pos)+1); val,end=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s[start:]); token=s[start:start+end]; assert val==x['object']['statement']
 x['newline']=raw.endswith(bytes([10])); x['statement_tokens']={'statement':{'raw_token':token,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),'decoded_sha256':hashlib.sha256(val.encode()).hexdigest()}}
 print(x['id'],val,'\n')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','fixed20-provenance.json'],input=json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
a=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); print('HISTORY TYPE',type(a).__name__)
print('RECENT EXACT',[p for p in a if any('expanded-corpus-r'+str(k)+'/' in p for k in range(404,412))])
print('DENIALS',Path('inherited-denials.json').read_text())
